get_training_parser: build an argparse parser with dataset, distributed training, model, optimization, and checkpoint arguments for fairseq training
get_generation_parser: build an argparse parser with dataset, generation, and checkpoint arguments for fairseq inference or interactive use
parse_args_and_arch: parse command line arguments and dynamically add model-specific and task-specific args then post-process them
get_args: build a training args namespace from a data path, task name, and architecture with optional overrides
get_preprocessing_parser: build an argparse parser with source and target language, dictionary, and binarization arguments for preprocessing data
